features: League cross analysis: when both drivers use Steward, the HUD, OBS and report show the result built from both cars' data
Leagues with steward decisions: the HUD and OBS show "Awaiting decision" and then the stewards' decision, including revisions
League version of the report with League ID and the Steward for Leagues logo
When the stewards publish a decision, the report is generated right away, with the penalty, who published it and the justification
Resize the in-game HUD from 100% down to 85% with the handle in its corner (double-click to reset)
improvements: The result of the cross analysis is mirrored in both drivers' HUDs
In leagues, a contact between two cars always shows the league result, so both drivers see the same numbers; if the other report does not arrive within 3 minutes the HUD says so
Incident data sent to the league now includes pedal and steering inputs
The HUD history now shows incident type, X points, car number and your share, colored by who was the primary contributor
The HUD history scrolls with the mouse wheel and keeps your last incidents
Impact side is now measured correctly in fast corners, where cornering force was mistaken for the contact
The other car is identified more reliably: nearby cars that received incident points and the side of the impact are both taken into account
A full 100% share is now given only in clear-cut cases (clean rear-end, unsafe rejoin, car ahead stopping abruptly)
Side-by-side contacts confirmed by the spotter are shared, unless the inside car ran over the kerb and moved out onto the other car
Contacts with a car rejoining from a paved run-off area are now recognized as unsafe rejoins
When the car ahead only braked normally, it is no longer treated as the main contributor
When the other car cannot be confirmed, the share is limited and the report says so
The incident image now shows only the game window, on the right monitor in multi-monitor setups
The trajectory chart no longer invents the other car's sideways path when it cannot be estimated
Track maps are now recorded in any session
